met_analysis:
The Low-Pressure Area over south Uttar Pradesh & adjoining northeast Madhya Pradesh lies over southeast Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 1730 Hrs IST of today, the 26th August 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extending upto 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes to pass through Jammu, Dehradun, centre of Low Pressure Area over southeast Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood, Daltonganj, Digha and thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The trough from centre of Low Pressure Area over southeast Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood to Northeast bay of Bengal across East Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Odisha persists and now seen upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood between 4.5 & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northwest Madhya Pradesh & neighbourhoodat 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Westcentral - Northwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining north Andhra Pradesh - South Odisha coasts lies over Northwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining Bangladesh at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Madhya Maharashtra & neighbourhood lies over Konkan & adjoining Eastcentral Arabian Sea at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
